decided: The steward runs at the archive of each change that belongs to a stage, and only when its own setting is on or the user asks for it; with nothing configured it never runs and the archive is as it is today.
alternatives: run it by default at every such archive
also run it when a change is proposed
run it only when a whole stage is finished
why: An extra independent review at every archive changes what the flow does and costs, which G0 forbids by default; at the archive the account and the full change exist, and judging a whole stage at once would come after up to four changes had already landed.

defines.definition: An independent reviewer, never the session that did the work, asked one question about a finished change: is it still the stage of the architecture doc it says it belongs to?
The AI's own plain-language record, written when a change's building is finished, of what it built and where it left its stage's plan.
